**Plan**
- A server Script loads each player's coins and a list of already-granted PurchaseIds from one DataStore key, and shows them in `leaderstats.Coins`.
- `ProcessReceipt` grants 500 coins for the product inside a single `UpdateAsync` call that checks the PurchaseId list first, so a purchase can never be granted twice and the grant and the receipt record are saved together.
- It returns `PurchaseGranted` only after that save succeeds; any failure returns `NotProcessedYet` so Roblox retries.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/CoinProduct)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local COIN_PRODUCT_ID = 1234567890 -- CONFIGURE: your developer product id
local COIN_AMOUNT = 500
local MAX_RECEIPTS = 200
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CoinData_v1")

type Data = {coins: number, receipts: {string}}

local function retry(fn: () -> any): (boolean, any)
	for attempt = 1, 5 do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		task.wait(attempt)
	end
	return false, nil
end

local loaded: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = stats
	stats.Parent = player

	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok then
		coins.Value = if type(data) == "table" and type((data :: any).coins) == "number" then (data :: any).coins else 0
		loaded[player] = true
	else
		player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin.")
	end
end)

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local coins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not loaded[player] or not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end
	local value = coins.Value
	retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old: any)
			local data: Data = if type(old) == "table" then old else {coins = 0, receipts = {}}
			data.coins = value
			return data
		end)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	saveCoins(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(info: {[string]: any}): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)
	if not player or not loaded[player] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if info.ProductId ~= COIN_PRODUCT_ID then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local purchaseId = tostring(info.PurchaseId)
	local alreadyGranted = false
	local ok = retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. info.PlayerId, function(old: any)
			local data: Data = if type(old) == "table" then old else {coins = 0, receipts = {}}
			data.receipts = data.receipts or {}
			if table.find(data.receipts, purchaseId) then
				alreadyGranted = true
				return nil
			end
			data.coins = (data.coins or 0) + COIN_AMOUNT
			table.insert(data.receipts, purchaseId)
			while #data.receipts > MAX_RECEIPTS do
				table.remove(data.receipts, 1)
			end
			return data
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	if not alreadyGranted then
		local coins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coins and coins:IsA("IntValue") then
			coins.Value += COIN_AMOUNT
		end
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end
```

The PurchaseId check and the coin grant happen inside one UpdateAsync transaction, so Roblox retrying a receipt after a crash or a rejoin finds the id already recorded and does not pay twice. `PurchaseGranted` is returned only after the save succeeded, and any DataStore failure or missing player returns `NotProcessedYet`, which makes Roblox ask again later. Set `COIN_PRODUCT_ID` to your product.

**Plan**
- One dual-context source: when a player joins, the server reads `{coins, lastDay, streak}` with UpdateAsync, using the UTC day number (`os.time() // 86400`).
- Same day means no reward, exactly one day later extends the streak, and any bigger gap resets it to 1; the reward grows with the streak (50 coins per day, capped at day 7).
- The server awards the coins on `leaderstats.Coins` and tells the client with a RemoteEvent, which shows a toast.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/DailyReward). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/DailyRewardClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local REWARD_PER_DAY = 50
local MAX_STREAK_FOR_REWARD = 7

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
	local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("DailyReward_v1")
	local rewardEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	rewardEvent.Name = "DailyReward"
	rewardEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

	type Data = {lastDay: number, streak: number}

	local function claim(player: Player)
		local today = os.time() // 86400
		local streak, amount = 0, 0
		local ok = false
		for attempt = 1, 4 do
			ok = pcall(function()
				store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old: any)
					local data: Data = if type(old) == "table" then old else {lastDay = 0, streak = 0}
					local gap = today - (data.lastDay or 0)
					if gap == 0 then
						streak = data.streak
						return nil
					end
					data.streak = if gap == 1 then (data.streak or 0) + 1 else 1
					data.lastDay = today
					streak = data.streak
					amount = REWARD_PER_DAY * math.min(streak, MAX_STREAK_FOR_REWARD)
					return data
				end)
			end)
			if ok then
				break
			end
			task.wait(attempt)
		end
		if ok and amount > 0 and player.Parent then
			local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
			if coins and coins:IsA("IntValue") then
				coins.Value += amount
			end
			rewardEvent:FireClient(player, streak, amount)
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		coins.Name = "Coins"
		coins.Parent = stats
		stats.Parent = player
		task.spawn(claim, player)
	end)
else
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local rewardEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DailyReward") :: RemoteEvent

	rewardEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(streak: unknown, amount: unknown)
		if type(streak) ~= "number" or type(amount) ~= "number" then
			return
		end
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "DailyRewardToast"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.AnchorPoint, label.Position = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -80)
		label.Size, label.BackgroundColor3 = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 64), Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 46)
		label.TextColor3, label.Font, label.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 22
		label.Text = string.format("Day %d streak!  +%d coins", streak, amount)
		label.Parent = gui
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
		corner.Parent = label
		gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		TweenService:Create(label, info, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24)}):Play()
		task.delay(4, function()
			local out = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -80)})
			out:Play()
			out.Completed:Wait()
			gui:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end
```

Everything uses the UTC day number, so the result is identical on every server. Inside a single UpdateAsync the script compares today with the last claimed day: the same day returns without changes, exactly one day later adds to the streak, and any longer gap resets it to 1. The reward is 50 coins times the streak (up to 7), and the client toast is shown only when coins were actually granted.

**Plan**
- Find every Model tagged "Plot" (each needs parts named Dropper, Collector and ClaimPad); if none exist, build one default plot so the script works out of the box.
- A player touching an unowned ClaimPad becomes the plot owner (stored as an attribute); ownership is released when they leave.
- Every 2 seconds each owned plot's Dropper spawns an Ore part; when Ore touches the Collector it is destroyed and its value is added to the owner's `Cash` leaderstat.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/TycoonDropper)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local DROP_INTERVAL = 2
local ORE_VALUE = 10
local PLOT_TAG = "Plot"

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3, parent: Instance): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = position
	part.Color = color
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function ensureDefaultPlot()
	if #CollectionService:GetTagged(PLOT_TAG) > 0 then
		return
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "DefaultPlot"
	makePart("Base", Vector3.new(30, 1, 30), Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 60), Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85), model)
	makePart("ClaimPad", Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 6), Vector3.new(-10, 1.25, 52), Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90), model)
	makePart("Dropper", Vector3.new(4, 4, 4), Vector3.new(0, 14, 60), Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 40), model)
	makePart("Collector", Vector3.new(8, 1, 8), Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 60), Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 230), model)
	CollectionService:AddTag(model, PLOT_TAG)
	model.Parent = workspace
end

local function addCash(player: Player, amount: number)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cash = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cash and cash:IsA("IntValue") then
		cash.Value += amount
	end
end

local function setupPlot(plot: Instance)
	if not plot:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local dropper = plot:FindFirstChild("Dropper")
	local collector = plot:FindFirstChild("Collector")
	local claimPad = plot:FindFirstChild("ClaimPad")
	if not (dropper and dropper:IsA("BasePart") and collector and collector:IsA("BasePart") and claimPad and claimPad:IsA("BasePart")) then
		warn("Plot " .. plot.Name .. " needs Dropper, Collector and ClaimPad parts")
		return
	end

	claimPad.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		local player = if hit.Parent then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) else nil
		if player and plot:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == nil then
			for _, other in CollectionService:GetTagged(PLOT_TAG) do
				if other:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == player.UserId then
					return
				end
			end
			plot:SetAttribute("OwnerId", player.UserId)
		end
	end)

	collector.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		if hit.Name ~= "Ore" or hit:GetAttribute("Collected") == true then
			return
		end
		hit:SetAttribute("Collected", true)
		local ownerId = plot:GetAttribute("OwnerId")
		local owner = if type(ownerId) == "number" then Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId) else nil
		if owner then
			local value = hit:GetAttribute("Value")
			addCash(owner, if type(value) == "number" then value else ORE_VALUE)
		end
		hit:Destroy()
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while plot.Parent do
			task.wait(DROP_INTERVAL)
			if plot:GetAttribute("OwnerId") ~= nil then
				local ore = Instance.new("Part")
				ore.Name = "Ore"
				ore.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
				ore.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60)
				ore.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				ore.Position = dropper.Position - Vector3.new(0, dropper.Size.Y / 2 + 1, 0)
				ore:SetAttribute("Value", ORE_VALUE)
				ore.Parent = workspace
				Debris:AddItem(ore, 15)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cash.Name = "Cash"
	cash.Parent = stats
	stats.Parent = player
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	for _, plot in CollectionService:GetTagged(PLOT_TAG) do
		if plot:GetAttribute("OwnerId") == player.UserId then
			plot:SetAttribute("OwnerId", nil)
		end
	end
end)

ensureDefaultPlot()
for _, plot in CollectionService:GetTagged(PLOT_TAG) do
	task.spawn(setupPlot, plot)
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(PLOT_TAG):Connect(setupPlot)
```

Ownership, ore creation and cash all live on the server. Each plot only drops ore while someone owns it, and the Collected flag stops one ore from paying out twice if it touches the collector more than once. A player can own at most one plot, and leaving frees it for someone else.

- One dual-context source: the server defines eggs with a coin price and a weighted list of pets (common, rare, legendary), and a RemoteFunction `HatchEgg(eggId)`.
- The server validates the egg id and cooldown, checks and deducts the coins, then rolls a pet with `Random` weighted by each pet's weight.
- The result is stored in the server's pet list and returned; the client shows an egg button and the hatched pet in its rarity colour.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/PetEggs). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/PetEggsClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

type Pet = {name: string, rarity: string, weight: number}
type Egg = {price: number, pets: {Pet}}
local EGGS: {[string]: Egg} = {
	BasicEgg = {price = 100, pets = {
		{name = "Dog", rarity = "Common", weight = 40},
		{name = "Cat", rarity = "Common", weight = 30},
		{name = "Fox", rarity = "Rare", weight = 20},
		{name = "Panda", rarity = "Rare", weight = 5},
		{name = "Dragon", rarity = "Legendary", weight = 1},
	}},
}
local RARITY_COLORS: {[string]: Color3} = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210), Rare = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255), Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40),
}

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local hatch = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	hatch.Name = "HatchEgg"
	hatch.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	local rng = Random.new()
	local lastHatch: {[Player]: number} = {}
	local pets: {[Player]: {string}} = {}

	local function roll(egg: Egg): Pet
		local total = 0
		for _, pet in egg.pets do
			total += pet.weight
		end
		local pick = rng:NextNumber(0, total)
		for _, pet in egg.pets do
			pick -= pet.weight
			if pick <= 0 then
				return pet
			end
		end
		return egg.pets[#egg.pets]
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		pets[player] = {}
		local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
		stats.Name = "leaderstats"
		local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		coins.Name, coins.Value = "Coins", 1000
		coins.Parent = stats
		stats.Parent = player
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		pets[player], lastHatch[player] = nil, nil
	end)

	hatch.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, eggId: unknown): (boolean, string, string)
		local egg = if type(eggId) == "string" then EGGS[eggId] else nil
		local coins = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if not egg or not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") or not pets[player] then
			return false, "Invalid egg", ""
		end
		if os.clock() - (lastHatch[player] or 0) < 1 then
			return false, "Slow down", ""
		end
		lastHatch[player] = os.clock()
		if coins.Value < egg.price then
			return false, "Not enough coins", ""
		end
		coins.Value -= egg.price
		local pet = roll(egg)
		table.insert(pets[player], pet.name)
		player:SetAttribute("PetCount", #pets[player])
		return true, pet.name, pet.rarity
	end
else
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local hatch = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HatchEgg") :: RemoteFunction

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn = "EggShop", false
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.AnchorPoint, frame.Position = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -100)
	frame.Size, frame.BackgroundColor3 = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 150), Color3.fromRGB(28, 31, 42)
	frame.Parent = gui
	local result = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	result.Position, result.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 76), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 60)
	result.BackgroundTransparency, result.TextColor3 = 1, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	result.Font, result.TextSize, result.Text = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 24, "Hatch an egg!"
	result.Parent = frame
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Position, button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 56)
	button.BackgroundColor3, button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	button.Font, button.TextSize = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 20
	button.Text = string.format("Hatch Basic Egg (%d coins)", EGGS.BasicEgg.price)
	button.Parent = frame
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		local ok, name, rarity = hatch:InvokeServer("BasicEgg")
		if ok then
			result.Text = string.format("%s (%s)", name, rarity)
			result.TextColor3 = RARITY_COLORS[rarity] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		else
			result.Text, result.TextColor3 = name, Color3.fromRGB(240, 110, 110)
		end
	end)
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
```

The odds table and the random roll exist only on the server: a pet's chance is its weight divided by the total (here 40/30/20/5/1 out of 96, so the Dragon is roughly 1%). The coins are deducted before the roll, the cooldown stops spam, and the client only learns the outcome after it is final. The pet is recorded in the server's list for that player.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/RotatingShop). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/RotatingShopClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

type Item = {id: string, price: number}
local POOL: {Item} = {
	{id = "Wooden Sword", price = 50}, {id = "Iron Sword", price = 150}, {id = "Gold Sword", price = 400},
	{id = "Leather Cap", price = 40}, {id = "Iron Helmet", price = 120}, {id = "Magic Hat", price = 300},
	{id = "Speed Boots", price = 200}, {id = "Jump Boots", price = 220}, {id = "Health Potion", price = 25},
	{id = "Mana Potion", price = 25}, {id = "Rare Gem", price = 500}, {id = "Pet Treat", price = 60},
}
local STOCK_SIZE = 4

local function currentStock(): ({Item}, number)
	local hourIndex = os.time() // 3600
	local rng = Random.new(hourIndex)
	local indexes: {number} = {}
	for i = 1, #POOL do
		indexes[i] = i
	end
	for i = #indexes, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		indexes[i], indexes[j] = indexes[j], indexes[i]
	end
	local stock: {Item} = {}
	for i = 1, STOCK_SIZE do
		stock[i] = POOL[indexes[i]]
	end
	return stock, (hourIndex + 1) * 3600 - os.time()
end

	for i = 1, STOCK_SIZE do

		button.BackgroundColor3, button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 66, 90), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/IslandGenerator)
local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
local CELL = 4
local GRID = 72
local RADIUS = 120
local PEAK = 70
local DEPTH = 24
local SEED = 421
local half = GRID * CELL / 2

local function heightAt(x: number, z: number): number
	local dist = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z) / RADIUS
	local shape = 1 - dist * dist
	local cone = math.max(0, 1 - dist * 2.2)
	local rough = math.noise(x / 40, z / 40, SEED) * 5 * math.max(0, shape)
	local top = shape * 20 - 6 + cone ^ 1.5 * PEAK + rough
	return math.max(top, -DEPTH + 2 * CELL)
end

local function surfaceMaterial(top: number): Enum.Material
	if top < 5 then
		return Enum.Material.Sand
	elseif top > 38 then
		return Enum.Material.Rock
	end
	return Enum.Material.Grass
end

local function buildColumn(x: number, z: number)
	local top = heightAt(x, z)
	local coreTop = top - CELL
	local core = if top < 6 then Enum.Material.Sand else Enum.Material.Rock
	Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, (coreTop - DEPTH) / 2, z), Vector3.new(CELL, coreTop + DEPTH, CELL), core)
	Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(x, top - CELL / 2, z), Vector3.new(CELL, CELL, CELL), surfaceMaterial(top))
end

Terrain:Clear()
Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, -DEPTH / 2, 0), Vector3.new(GRID * CELL, DEPTH, GRID * CELL), Enum.Material.Water)
for i = 0, GRID - 1 do

	end

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/MazeGenerator)
local N = 20
local CELL = 12
local HEIGHT = 10
local THICK = 1.5
local rng = Random.new()

type Cell = { visited: boolean, walls: { [string]: boolean } }
local DIRS = {
	{ name = "N", dx = 0, dy = -1, opposite = "S" },
	{ name = "S", dx = 0, dy = 1, opposite = "N" },
	{ name = "E", dx = 1, dy = 0, opposite = "W" },
	{ name = "W", dx = -1, dy = 0, opposite = "E" },
}

local grid: { { Cell } } = {}
for x = 1, N do
	grid[x] = {}
	for y = 1, N do
		grid[x][y] = { visited = false, walls = { N = true, E = true, S = true, W = true } }
	end
end

local stack: { Vector2 } = { Vector2.new(1, 1) }
grid[1][1].visited = true
while #stack > 0 do
	local cur = stack[#stack]
	local options = {}
	for _, d in DIRS do
		local row = grid[cur.X + d.dx]
		local cell = if row then row[cur.Y + d.dy] else nil
		if cell and not cell.visited then
			table.insert(options, d)
		end
	end
	if #options == 0 then
		table.remove(stack)
	else
		local d = options[rng:NextInteger(1, #options)]
		local nx, ny = cur.X + d.dx, cur.Y + d.dy
		grid[cur.X][cur.Y].walls[d.name] = false
		grid[nx][ny].walls[d.opposite] = false
		grid[nx][ny].visited = true
		table.insert(stack, Vector2.new(nx, ny))
	end
end
grid[1][1].walls.N = false
grid[N][N].walls.S = false

maze.Name = "Maze"

		if w.W then makePart(vert, Vector3.new(cx - CELL / 2, HEIGHT / 2, cz), wallColor) end
		if w.S and y == N then makePart(horiz, Vector3.new(cx, HEIGHT / 2, cz + CELL / 2), wallColor) end

spawn.Neutral = true

The DFS keeps a stack of cells: it looks at unvisited neighbours, removes the wall between the current cell and a random one, and pushes it; with no free neighbour it pops back. Because every cell is visited exactly once through a spanning tree, the maze has one path between any two cells and never contains a sealed-off area. Building only north and west walls per cell (plus the outer south and east edges) avoids duplicate Parts.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/DungeonGenerator)
local TILE = 8
local MAP = 60
local ROOM_COUNT = 9
local rng = Random.new()

type Room = { x: number, z: number, w: number, h: number, cx: number, cz: number, links: { number }, floor: Part }
local rooms: { Room } = {}
local dungeon = Instance.new("Model")
dungeon.Name = "Dungeon"

local function makeFloor(minX: number, minZ: number, sizeX: number, sizeZ: number, y: number, color: Color3): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = Vector3.new(sizeX * TILE, 1, sizeZ * TILE)
	p.Position = Vector3.new((minX + sizeX / 2) * TILE, y, (minZ + sizeZ / 2) * TILE)
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone
	p.Parent = dungeon
	return p
end

local attempts = 0
while #rooms < ROOM_COUNT and attempts < 500 do
	attempts += 1
	local w, h = rng:NextInteger(5, 10), rng:NextInteger(5, 10)
	local x, z = rng:NextInteger(1, MAP - w - 1), rng:NextInteger(1, MAP - h - 1)
	local overlaps = false
	for _, r in rooms do
		if x < r.x + r.w + 2 and x + w + 2 > r.x and z < r.z + r.h + 2 and z + h + 2 > r.z then
			overlaps = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not overlaps then
		local floor = makeFloor(x, z, w, h, 0, Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120))
		table.insert(rooms, { x = x, z = z, w = w, h = h, cx = x + w // 2, cz = z + h // 2, links = {}, floor = floor })
	end
end

local corridorColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
for i = 2, #rooms do
	local a, nearest, best = rooms[i], 1, math.huge
	for j = 1, i - 1 do
		local d = math.abs(a.cx - rooms[j].cx) + math.abs(a.cz - rooms[j].cz)
		if d < best then nearest, best = j, d end
	end
	local b = rooms[nearest]
	table.insert(a.links, nearest)
	table.insert(b.links, i)
	local x1, x2 = math.min(a.cx, b.cx), math.max(a.cx, b.cx)
	local z1, z2 = math.min(a.cz, b.cz), math.max(a.cz, b.cz)
	makeFloor(x1 - 1, a.cz - 1, x2 - x1 + 2, 2, -0.05, corridorColor)
	makeFloor(b.cx - 1, z1 - 1, 2, z2 - z1 + 2, -0.05, corridorColor)
end

local dist: { [number]: number } = { [1] = 0 }
local queue = { 1 }
local head = 1
while head <= #queue do
	local i = queue[head]
	head += 1
	for _, j in rooms[i].links do
		if dist[j] == nil then
			dist[j] = dist[i] + 1
			table.insert(queue, j)
		end
	end
end
local boss = 1
for i, d in dist do
	if d > dist[boss] then boss = i end
end

rooms[1].floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 190, 90)
if boss ~= 1 then
	local bossRoom = rooms[boss]
	bossRoom.floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 40, 40)
	local altar = makeFloor(bossRoom.cx - 1, bossRoom.cz - 1, 2, 2, 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
	altar.Name = "BossAltar"
	altar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
end

local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Anchored = true
spawn.Neutral = true
spawn.Position = Vector3.new(rooms[1].cx * TILE, 2, rooms[1].cz * TILE)
spawn.Parent = workspace
dungeon.Parent = workspace

The boss room is the one with the greatest number of room-to-room hops from the spawn room, found by BFS over the recorded links, which means the player really has to cross the dungeon to reach it. Corridor floors sit 0.05 studs lower than rooms so they never z-fight where they overlap.

local placed: { Vector3 } = {}

local function newPart(size: Vector3, shape: Enum.PartType, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Shape = shape
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	return p
end

local function farEnough(pos: Vector3): boolean
	for _, other in placed do
		if (other - pos).Magnitude < MIN_GAP then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function makeTree(pos: Vector3)
	local height = rng:NextNumber(6, 10)
	local yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), 0)
	local trunk = newPart(Vector3.new(1.4, height, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Block, Color3.fromRGB(105, 75, 50), Enum.Material.Wood)
	trunk.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * yaw * CFrame.new(0, height / 2 - 0.5, 0)
	local crown = rng:NextNumber(6, 9)
	local leaves = newPart(Vector3.new(crown, crown, crown), Enum.PartType.Ball, Color3.fromRGB(55, 130, 60), Enum.Material.Grass)
	leaves.CanCollide = false
	leaves.Position = pos + Vector3.new(0, height + crown / 4, 0)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Tree"
	trunk.Parent = model
	leaves.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = trunk
	model.Parent = folder
end

local function makeRock(pos: Vector3)
	local s = Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(2, 5), rng:NextNumber(1.5, 4), rng:NextNumber(2, 5))
	local rock = newPart(s, Enum.PartType.Block, Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 115), Enum.Material.Slate)
	local tilt = CFrame.Angles(rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3), rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), rng:NextNumber(-0.3, 0.3))
	rock.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, s.Y * 0.3, 0)) * tilt
	rock.Name = "Rock"
	rock.Parent = folder
end

local count, tries = 0, 0
while count < COUNT and tries < MAX_TRIES do
	tries += 1
	local x = rng:NextNumber(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2)
	local z = rng:NextNumber(-AREA / 2, AREA / 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 500, z), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), params)
	if hit and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water and hit.Normal.Y > 0.75 and hit.Position.Y > 1.5 and farEnough(hit.Position) then
		if hit.Material == Enum.Material.Grass and rng:NextNumber() < 0.7 then
			makeTree(hit.Position)
		else
			makeRock(hit.Position)
		end
		table.insert(placed, hit.Position)
		count += 1
	end
	if tries % 25 == 0 then
		task.wait()
	end
end
folder.Parent = workspace
print(("Placed %d objects in %d tries"):format(count, tries))
```

Rays are limited to Terrain and told not to skip water, so a ray over a lake returns a Water hit that the script rejects, instead of landing on the seabed. The hit position is the real ground point, so trunks and rocks are lowered slightly into the slope to avoid floating edges. The 7-stud spacing check, slope check and try limit keep the loop finite even if the terrain is mostly ocean.

**Plan**
- A LocalScript derives the time from `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()`, so every client shows the same time with no remote traffic: 24 in-game hours span 600 real seconds.
- Each frame it sets `Lighting.ClockTime` and blends ambient, outdoor ambient, brightness and fog between night and day colours using the sun's height.
- A warm tint appears around sunrise and sunset, and an `IsNight` attribute on Lighting tells other local scripts when it changes.

```lua
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/DayNightCycle)
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DAY_LENGTH = 600
local START_CLOCK = 8

local NIGHT = {
	ambient = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 40),
	outdoor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 64),
	fog = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 32),
	brightness = 0.15,
}
local DAY = {
	ambient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 115, 125),
	outdoor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175),
	fog = Color3.fromRGB(190, 205, 225),
	brightness = 2.2,
}
local SUNSET_TINT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 60)
local NO_TINT = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

local function sunHeight(clock: number): number
	return math.sin((clock - 6) / 12 * math.pi)
end

local function clockNow(): number
	return (START_CLOCK + workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 24 / DAY_LENGTH) % 24
end

local function apply(clock: number)
	local sun = sunHeight(clock)
	local day = math.clamp(sun * 3, 0, 1)
	local twilight = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(sun) * 4, 0, 1)

	Lighting.ClockTime = clock
	Lighting.Ambient = NIGHT.ambient:Lerp(DAY.ambient, day)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = NIGHT.outdoor:Lerp(DAY.outdoor, day)
	Lighting.FogColor = NIGHT.fog:Lerp(DAY.fog, day)
	Lighting.Brightness = NIGHT.brightness + (DAY.brightness - NIGHT.brightness) * day
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = NO_TINT:Lerp(SUNSET_TINT, twilight * 0.5)

	local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
	if atmosphere then
		atmosphere.Color = NIGHT.fog:Lerp(DAY.fog, day)
		atmosphere.Density = 0.45 - 0.15 * day
	end

	local isNight = day <= 0
	if Lighting:GetAttribute("IsNight") ~= isNight then
		Lighting:SetAttribute("IsNight", isNight)
	end
end

apply(clockNow())
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	apply(clockNow())
end)
```

`clockNow` maps real seconds to hours (a full 24 hours every 600 seconds, starting at 08:00) and uses server time, so late joiners and every player see the same sky. The sun-height sine is zero at 06:00 and 18:00, so the day factor is clamped to zero all night and rises quickly at dawn; ambient, brightness and fog are simply lerped by that factor, with an orange colour shift added near the horizon.

**Plan**
- Road segments are 40-stud Parts laid along the negative Z axis at index * 40; a few segments carry a deadly obstacle block.
- Every 0.2 s the script finds the furthest-forward and furthest-back player; it spawns segments until the track extends 240 studs beyond the leader and destroys segments more than 80 studs behind the last player.
- The obstacle layout is seeded from the segment index so it is deterministic and cheap.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/RunnerTrack)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SEG_LEN = 40
local SEG_WIDTH = 24
local AHEAD = 240
local BEHIND = 80
local TICK = 0.2

local track = Instance.new("Folder")
track.Name = "Track"
track.Parent = workspace

local segments: { [number]: Part } = {}
local nextIndex = 0
local oldest = 0

local function killOnTouch(obstacle: Part)
	local debounce = false
	obstacle.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		if debounce then return end
		local humanoid = if hit.Parent then hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			debounce = true
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end)
end

local function spawnSegment(i: number)
	local rng = Random.new(i)
	local road = Instance.new("Part")
	road.Name = "Segment" .. i
	road.Anchored = true
	road.Size = Vector3.new(SEG_WIDTH, 1, SEG_LEN)
	road.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -i * SEG_LEN)
	road.Material = Enum.Material.Asphalt
	road.Color = if i % 2 == 0 then Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 60) else Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 70)
	if i >= 3 and rng:NextNumber() < 0.6 then
		local obstacle = Instance.new("Part")
		obstacle.Name = "Obstacle"
		obstacle.Anchored = true
		obstacle.Size = Vector3.new(rng:NextInteger(4, 10), 4, 2)
		obstacle.Position = road.Position + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-8, 8), 2.5, rng:NextNumber(-12, 12))
		obstacle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 50)
		obstacle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		killOnTouch(obstacle)
		obstacle.Parent = road
	end
	road.Parent = track
	segments[i] = road
end

local startPad = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
startPad.Anchored = true
startPad.Neutral = true
startPad.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
startPad.Parent = workspace
for _ = 1, 6 do
	spawnSegment(nextIndex)
	nextIndex += 1
end

local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < TICK then return end
	elapsed = 0
	local lead, rear, found = math.huge, -math.huge, false
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local root = if player.Character then player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			found = true
			lead = math.min(lead, root.Position.Z)
			rear = math.max(rear, root.Position.Z)
		end
	end
	if not found then return end
	while -nextIndex * SEG_LEN > lead - AHEAD do
		spawnSegment(nextIndex)
		nextIndex += 1
	end
	while oldest < nextIndex and -oldest * SEG_LEN > rear + BEHIND do
		segments[oldest]:Destroy()
		segments[oldest] = nil
		oldest += 1
	end
end)
```

Players run towards negative Z, so a segment is behind them when its Z is larger than theirs. Generation is driven by the furthest-ahead player and cleanup by the furthest-behind one, which keeps multiplayer runs consistent, and the 0.2 s tick keeps the work tiny. Obstacles are children of their segment, so `Destroy` removes them and their connections together.

**Plan**
- The server script creates a `MapVote` RemoteEvent and a `RoundEnded` BindableEvent in ServerStorage; your round script fires `RoundEnded` and the vote starts.
- It picks up to 3 random maps from `ServerStorage.Maps`, accepts one vote per player (validated: string, among the options, voting open, 0.25 s cooldown), and broadcasts the live tally.
- After 15 seconds it picks the winner (random among ties), replaces `workspace.CurrentMap` with a clone of the winning model and announces it; the client half of the same file shows the voting buttons.

```lua
--!strict
-- Script (ServerScriptService/MapVote). The identical source is also saved as a LocalScript at StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/MapVoteClient (it branches on RunService).
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VOTE_TIME = 15

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "MapVote"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	local roundEnded = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	roundEnded.Name = "RoundEnded"
	roundEnded.Parent = ServerStorage
	local maps = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Maps")
	local rng = Random.new()
	local options: { string } = {}
	local votes: { [Player]: string } = {}
	local lastVote: { [Player]: number } = {}
	local active = false

	local function tally(): { [string]: number }
		local counts: { [string]: number } = {}
		for _, name in options do counts[name] = 0 end
		for _, choice in votes do counts[choice] += 1 end
		return counts
	end

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, choice: unknown)
		if not active or typeof(choice) ~= "string" or not table.find(options, choice) then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastVote[player] or 0) < 0.25 then return end
		lastVote[player] = now
		votes[player] = choice
		remote:FireAllClients("Tally", tally())
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		votes[player] = nil
		lastVote[player] = nil
	end)

	roundEnded.Event:Connect(function()
		if active then return end
		local pool = maps:GetChildren()
		options = {}
		for _ = 1, math.min(3, #pool) do
			local picked = table.remove(pool, rng:NextInteger(1, #pool))
			if picked then table.insert(options, picked.Name) end
		end
		if #options == 0 then return end
		votes, active = {}, true
		remote:FireAllClients("Open", options, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + VOTE_TIME)
		task.wait(VOTE_TIME)
		active = false
		local counts = tally()
		local best = -1
		local winners: { string } = {}
		for _, name in options do
			if counts[name] > best then
				best, winners = counts[name], { name }
			elseif counts[name] == best then
				table.insert(winners, name)
			end
		end
		local winner = winners[rng:NextInteger(1, #winners)]
		local template = maps:FindFirstChild(winner)
		if template then
			local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentMap")
			if old then old:Destroy() end
			local clone = template:Clone()
			clone.Name = "CurrentMap"
			clone.Parent = workspace
		end
		remote:FireAllClients("Result", winner)
	end)
else
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MapVote") :: RemoteEvent
	local currentOptions: { string } = {}
	local buttons: { TextButton } = {}

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "MapVoteGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Enabled = false
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 250)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 40)
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	layout.Parent = frame
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.Parent = frame
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 50)
		button.TextSize = 22
		button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 90, 160)
		button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			local name = currentOptions[i]
			if name then remote:FireServer(name) end
		end)
		button.Parent = frame
		buttons[i] = button
	end

	local function render(counts: { [string]: number })
		for i, button in buttons do
			local name = currentOptions[i]
			button.Visible = name ~= nil
			if name then button.Text = name .. "  (" .. (counts[name] or 0) .. ")" end
		end
	end

	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, a: any, b: any)
		if kind == "Open" then
			currentOptions = a
			render({})
			gui.Enabled = true
			while gui.Enabled and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < b do
				title.Text = "Vote for the next map: " .. math.ceil(b - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		elseif kind == "Tally" then
			render(a)
		elseif kind == "Result" then
			title.Text = "Next map: " .. tostring(a)
			task.wait(3)
			gui.Enabled = false
		end
	end)
	frame.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
```

Put your map models in a `Maps` folder in ServerStorage and fire `ServerStorage.RoundEnded` when a round finishes. The only thing a client can send is a map name, which the server accepts only while voting is open, only if it is one of the three offered options, and no faster than every 0.25 s; results come from the server's own vote table, and ties are broken randomly. The winner is cloned from ServerStorage, replacing the previous `CurrentMap`.
